video_title: Boogie - Wemby is TOP 3 in NBA + BEST Player in Spurs-Thunder Series!!

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama is a top-five player in the NBA right now
quotes.excerpt: I think he's without a doubt made a case as being a top-five player in this league.
quotes.quote: I think he's without a doubt made a case as being a top-five player in this league. It so happened that his coming-out party is during the playoffs, this entire playoff round, which is totally fine. This is still a young, up-and-coming player, full of potential, but he's also arrived in the moment. He's showing that he's here to stay, he's showing that he's the real deal. He's showing that he has the ability to carry his team at an early age and right now in the moment. It's crazy to say that he's a top-five player, top-three player in this league and also still have potential in the same statement, but that's just how good this kid is.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama is currently the third-best player in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I think he's probably closer to three than five if I'm being honest.
quotes.quote: I think he's probably closer to three than five if I'm being honest. I still put Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and Nikola Jokic over him, but this dude is unbelievable and he continues to get better and better. I think there's a whole another level that we haven't even seen yet, just given his age and just his youth of what he could even become more offensively. Obviously, we know his impact defense, it's one of the best defensive players we've already seen ever, and he's going to continue to expand his game offensively.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's dominance makes it impossible for opponents to stop him
quotes.excerpt: You look at when this guy dominates games, it's unfathomable.
quotes.quote: You look at when this guy dominates games, it's unfathomable. You're like, how do you stop this guy? He's scoring from inside, he's hitting bombs from three, he's blocking every shot at the rim. Guys are literally driving into the lane and turning around when they drive in the lane. And not only that, what a perfect situation for him to dominate Game 6, you get to rest back half of the fourth quarter, and then now to really cement a part of his legacy by willing his team back if he can win on the road at Oklahoma City.

quotes.speaker: Michelle Beadle
quotes.summary_phrase: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's lackluster performance in the series against the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: Playoff low 15 points, game worst plus-minus of minus-28. That's what happened in Game 6, Boogie.
quotes.quote: Playoff low 15 points, game worst plus-minus of minus-28. That's what happened in Game 6, Boogie. I know that we're in this weird zone where you either love the Thunder or you hate the Thunder, but it's a bit of a pass he's getting, no? That's a very pedestrian Game 6.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper's impact and potential as a rookie for the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: You talk about someone that can come in off the bench and impact the game, it's unreal.
quotes.quote: You talk about someone that can come in off the bench and impact the game, it's unreal. You look at the first two games of the series and when they won one in Oklahoma City, I was like, is he a rookie? Is he not a rookie? The way he moves, the way he's able to get space, the way he's fearless getting into the lane, it's almost like he's a season veteran at this point and you've kind of slowly seen that. The Spurs have done a good job of slowly giving you glimpses throughout the year, but yes, he has star potential.
